name: Asuka ~Kimi o Suki na Tatta Hitotsu no Tamashii~
original_name: 明日香　～キミを好きなたったひとつの魂～
source:
Spring of 1997.
A certain university 10 years after events of Toumei na Yasashisa.
Kenichi lives a normal student life. However, changes are knocking at the door. Spring brings sunlight, warmth, smiles and love.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1997年春天。
东明八失事件10年后的某大学。
健一过着正常的学生生活。然而，变化正在敲响大门。春天带来阳光、温暖、微笑和爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
